label: VERIFIED
extraction: OpenCode Skills Discovery: Skills loaded from .opencode/skills/, ~/.config/opencode/skills/, .claude/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, .agents/skills/, ~/.agents/skills/. Project-local walks up to git worktree. Global from home configs. Skills surfaced via native skill tool. Agents see available skills and load full content when needed. Skills vs MCP: MCP for external tools (browser, design, automation), Skills for internal workflows and reusable instructions. Both support permission control. Rule: Use MCP when agent needs to do something outside OpenCode; Use Skills when agent needs to know how to do something consistently. Frontmatter: name (required, matches folder), description (required), license/compatibility/metadata (optional).
